meta.description: Deviations from spec and unresolved ambiguities. Rules define what SHOULD be; this file tracks what ISN'T yet.

gaps.title: Hook Script Deployment
gaps.description: Current implementation uses direct cp/Copy-Item for hook scripts. Missing: backup_file before overwrite, deploy_managed_file interactive review, adopt/skip/merge options. User customizations are silently lost.
gaps.plannedFix: Upgrade to deploy_managed_file (same as markdown type). Adopt target: shared/hooks/<filename> in aitools repo.

gaps.title: JSON Config Backup (bash)
gaps.description: Bash versions do NOT call backup_file before settings.json merge. PowerShell versions DO call Backup-File. Platform parity gap.
gaps.plannedFix: Add backup_file call in bash before Node.js merge.

gaps.title: JSON Config Interactive Review
gaps.description: All JSON config merges are silent. Clobber detection blocks on field loss, but there is no 'here's what will change, proceed?' prompt.
gaps.plannedFix: Add field-level review menu showing changed managed fields with old → new values.

gaps.title: MCP Disable Scope (Cursor CLI)
gaps.description: agent mcp disable is project-scoped, not user-scoped. Setup runs it from the aitools repo directory only. Other projects see vercel/webflow as enabled, causing authentication errors on launch.
gaps.plannedFix: Stop deploying vercel/webflow to user-level mcp.json. Add per-project only via aitools --addmcp.

gaps.title: Backup Proliferation
gaps.description: backup_dir copies the entire directory including individual .bak.* files. Each backup contains older backups, causing cascading growth.
gaps.plannedFix: Exclude *.bak.* patterns from directory backup copies.
